name: io.github.oktopeak/mycase-mcp
description: Connect Claude to MyCase: cases, contacts, documents, tasks, calendar, calls, time, billing, staff.

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: MyCase OAuth client ID issued by MyCase support for your firm

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: MyCase OAuth client secret issued by MyCase support

environmentVariables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. 64-character hex key for encrypting stored OAuth tokens. If omitted, a key is auto-generated on first run and stored in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service / Windows Credential Manager).

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_REDIRECT_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local port for the OAuth callback listener (default: 5678). Must match the redirect URI registered with MyCase support.

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_EXPERIMENTAL_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable experimental tools (log-call) whose API endpoints are unverified.

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_AUTH_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the MyCase OAuth authorization endpoint URL.

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the MyCase OAuth token exchange endpoint URL.

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the MyCase API base URL (default: https://external-integrations.mycase.com/v1).

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_HTTP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTP transport mode only. The public base URL of this server (e.g. https://mycase-mcp.lawfirm.com). Used as the OAuth redirect URI base.

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_HTTP_API_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP transport mode only. Comma-separated list of userId:apiKey pairs for container deployments (e.g. alice@firm.com:sk_key1,bob@firm.com:sk_key2). Alternative to api-keys.json.

environmentVariables.name: MYCASE_API_KEYS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: HTTP transport mode only. Path to the API keys JSON file (default: ~/.oktopeak-mycase/api-keys.json).
